title: 第四章 水晶访客第五章 芯片秘闻
lines: 民国二十五年，上海的夏夜总裹着层化不开的湿热。凌峰坐在“归燕楼”后院的藤椅上，手里捏着那枚玉观音玉佩，指腹反复摩挲着内侧那点异样的“斑点”。院外是霞飞路的车水马龙，黄包车的铃铛声、洋行职员的说笑声混着远处工厂的汽笛声，织成一张属于这座城市的喧嚣网，可他心里却静得发慌。
三天前那场地痞骚扰，本该像掸掉桌角灰尘般容易处理——他留洋时学过几手拳术，对付三两个混混不在话下。可那晚不同，玉佩摔在青石板上时迸发的那缕蓝光，还有紧接着天边划过的那道转瞬即逝的银线，以及地痞们突然变了调的惊叫，都像根细针，扎在他脑子里，越想越觉得不对劲。
“在想什么呢？”刘佳琪端着碗冰镇绿豆汤走过来，素色旗袍的下摆随着脚步轻轻摆动。她将碗放在石桌上，挨着凌峰坐下，伸手替他拢了拢微敞的领口，“自打那晚之后，你就总对着这玉佩发呆，莫不是真信了什么神神叨叨的说法？”
凌峰转头看她，灯光下妻子的眉眼温温柔柔，带着刚嫁过来的羞怯与笃定。他们认识二十年，从穿开裆裤的年纪到如今共筑小家，她是他在这动荡时局里最稳的一块锚。可有些话，他不知该怎么说出口——总不能告诉她，自己怀疑这枚传了几代的玉佩，可能和“外太空”有关吧？那是他在国外报纸上看过的科幻小说情节，怎么会跑到现实里来？
“没什么，”他笑了笑，把玉佩揣回怀里，“就是觉得这玉有点怪，摸着手感和普通玉石不一样。”
刘佳琪舀了勺绿豆汤递到他嘴边，眼里带着点促狭：“再怪也是块玉，难不成还能变成活物？”
话音刚落，后院那扇老旧的木门突然“吱呀”一声自己开了道缝。晚风灌进来，带着股说不清的凉意，不像夏夜该有的湿热，倒像是深秋的寒气，刮得人皮肤发紧。
凌峰瞬间绷紧了脊背，下意识将刘佳琪往身后拉了拉。“谁？”他沉声喝问，目光锐利地扫向门口。这后院平时除了他和伙计，鲜少有人来，更别说这深更半夜的。
门缝里没有回应，只有风“呜呜”地往里钻，吹得墙角的竹扫帚“啪嗒”一声倒在地上。刘佳琪攥着凌峰的衣角，指尖微微发颤，却还是强作镇定：“会不会是……野猫？”
凌峰没说话，只是缓缓站起身。他记得傍晚关后院门时特意上了插销，这门是他请老木匠做的，插销紧实，绝不可能被风轻易吹开。他蹑手蹑脚地走过去，右手悄悄握住了门后那根用来顶门的粗木棍，猛地拉开了门——
门外空无一人。
只有巷子深处的路灯昏黄地亮着，将斑驳的墙影拉得老长。凌峰皱着眉探头看了看，左右都没见人影，连只猫的影子都没有。他正想转身关门，眼角余光却瞥见院子中央的石板地上，不知何时多了一团淡淡的光晕。
那光很奇特，不是电灯的刺眼白光，也不是烛火的暖黄，而是种近乎透明的、泛着淡淡蓝意的微光，像清晨湖面结的薄冰，又像雨后天空洗过的颜色。光晕不大，约莫一人高，边缘模糊，仿佛随时会散开。
“那是什么？”刘佳琪的声音带着颤音，从他身后传来。
凌峰的心“咚咚”跳得厉害，他慢慢走回院子，目光死死盯着那团光。光晕里似乎有什么东西在动，隐约能看出是个人形，可又不像真人——没有清晰的五官，没有分明的轮廓，就像用最纯净的水晶雕琢出来的，浑身都透着半透明的质感，连光线都能从“身体”里穿过去。
他想起国外报纸上那些关于“火星人”的插画，心里咯噔一下，一个荒诞却又挥之不去的念头冒了出来。
就在这时，那团光晕里的“水晶人”动了。它没有张嘴，也没有发出任何声音，可凌峰的脑子里却突然响起一个清晰的声音，像是有人在他耳边说话，又像是直接钻进了他的意识里：“不要怕。”
那声音很特别，分不清男女老少，语调平稳得没有一丝起伏，却奇异地让人感觉不到恶意。凌峰浑身一震，下意识看向刘佳琪：“你听到了吗？”
刘佳琪茫然地摇头：“听到什么？它没出声啊。”
凌峰这才意识到，这声音似乎只有他能听见。他定了定神，握紧了手里的木棍，对着那水晶人问道：“你是谁？想干什么？”
水晶人没有回答他的问题，而是“目光”（如果那团模糊的光影能算目光的话）转向了他怀里的玉佩，意识里的声音再次响起：“我是为它来的。”
凌峰下意识捂住胸口，那里正是玉佩贴着的地方。“你认识这玉佩？”
“不是玉佩，”水晶人的意识传来，“是里面的东西。”
“里面的东西？”凌峰愣住了，他把玉佩拿出来，举到灯光下仔细看。玉佩还是那枚玉观音，温润的白，雕刻精细，除了内侧那点微小的、非玉石的斑点，再没什么特别之处。“这里面能有什么？”
水晶人向前“飘”了一小段距离，它的移动悄无声息，没有脚步声，就像一团光在平移。离得近了，凌峰才看清，它的“身体”里似乎有无数细小的光点在流动，像把整个星空都揉碎了装在里面。
“导航芯片。”意识里的声音再次响起，带着一种陈述事实的平静，“朗斯星的导航芯片，我们的飞船需要它才能定位坐标。”
“朗斯星？”凌峰咀嚼着这个陌生的名字，心脏狂跳不止，“你是……外星人？”
这个问题问出口，连他自己都觉得荒唐。可眼前这水晶人，这只有他能听到的意识传音，还有三天前那道诡异的蓝光，都在逼着他相信这个超出认知的答案。
content_en:
In the 25th year of the Republic of China, summer nights in Shanghai were always wrapped in layers of humidity and heat. Ling Feng sat on a wicker chair in the backyard of "Guiyan Tower", holding the jade Guanyin jade pendant in his hand, and repeatedly rubbing the strange "spots" on the inside with his fingertips. Outside the hospital was the busy traffic on Xiafei Road. The ringing of rickshaw bells and the chatter and laughter of foreign bank employees mixed with the whistles of factories in the distance, forming a noisy network belonging to this city, but he was so quiet in his heart.
The harassment from the gangsters three days ago should have been as easy to deal with as dusting off the corner of the table - he had learned a few boxing skills while studying abroad, and it was no problem to deal with three or two gangsters. But that night was different. The blue light that burst out when the jade pendant fell on the bluestone, the fleeting silver line that followed across the horizon, and the hooligans' suddenly changed screams were all like thin needles, piercing his mind. The more he thought about it, the more something was wrong.
"What are you thinking about?" Liu Jiaqi came over with a bowl of iced mung bean soup, and the hem of her plain cheongsam swayed gently with her footsteps. She placed the bowl on the stone table, sat down next to Ling Feng, and stretched out her hands to close his slightly open collar, "Ever since that night, you have been staring at this jade pendant in a daze. Do you really believe in some mythical saying?"
Ling Feng turned to look at her. Under the light, his wife's eyebrows were gentle and gentle, with the shyness and determination of a newly married woman. They have known each other for twenty years, from the age when they wore crotchless pants to now building a family together, she is his most stable anchor in this turbulent situation. But there were some words that he didn't know how to say - he couldn't tell her that he suspected that this jade pendant that had been passed down for several generations might be related to "outer space", right? That was a science fiction plot he had read in foreign newspapers. How could it come to reality?
"It's nothing," he smiled and put the jade pendant back in his arms, "I just think this jade is a bit strange, and it feels different from ordinary jade."
Liu Jiaqi scooped up a spoonful of mung bean soup and handed it to his mouth, with a narrow look in her eyes: "No matter how weird it is, it's still a piece of jade. Is it possible that it can turn into a living thing?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the old wooden door in the backyard suddenly opened a crack with a "squeak" sound. The evening breeze blew in, carrying an indescribable coolness. It was not like the heat and humidity of a summer night, but more like the cold air of late autumn, which made people's skin feel tight.
Ling Feng tensed his back instantly and subconsciously pulled Liu Jiaqi behind him. "Who?" he asked in a deep voice, his eyes sharply scanning towards the door. Except for him and his guys, few people come to this backyard, let alone this late at night.
There was no response from the crack in the door, only the wind whining in, causing the bamboo broom in the corner to fall to the ground with a clatter. Liu Jiaqi clutched the corner of Ling Feng's clothes, her fingertips trembling slightly, but she still managed to stay calm: "Could it be...a wild cat?"
Ling Feng didn't speak, but stood up slowly. He remembered that when he closed the backyard door in the evening, he specially locked the latch. He asked an old carpenter to make this door. The latch was tight and could not be easily blown open by the wind. He tiptoed over, secretly grasped the thick wooden stick behind the door with his right hand, and yanked the door open——
There was no one outside the door.
Only the street lights in the depths of the alley were dimly lit, making the mottled wall shadows long. Ling Feng frowned and looked around, but saw no one on either side, not even a cat. He was about to turn around and close the door when, out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of a faint halo of light on the stone floor in the center of the yard.
The light was very strange. It was not the dazzling white light of the electric lamp, nor the warm yellow of the candlelight, but an almost transparent, faint blue light, like the thin ice on the lake in the early morning, or the washed color of the sky after rain. The halo was not big, about the height of a person, and the edges were blurry, as if it would disperse at any time.
"What is that?" Liu Jiaqi's voice came from behind him with a trembling voice.
Ling Feng's heart was beating hard. He slowly walked back to the yard, staring at the light. There seemed to be something moving in the halo, and it could be vaguely seen as a human figure, but it didn't look like a real person - there were no clear facial features, no clear outlines, it was like it was carved out of the purest crystal. The whole body had a translucent texture, and even light could pass through the "body".
He thought of the illustrations about "Martians" in foreign newspapers, and his heart skipped a beat, and a ridiculous but lingering thought came to him.
At this moment, the "Crystal Man" in the halo moved. It didn't open its mouth or make any sound, but a clear voice suddenly sounded in Lingfeng's mind, as if someone was speaking in his ear, or as if it penetrated directly into his consciousness: "Don't be afraid."
The voice was very special. He could not tell the difference between male, female, old or young. His tone was so smooth that there was no fluctuation at all, but it was strangely not malicious. Ling Feng was shocked and subconsciously looked at Liu Jiaqi: "Did you hear that?"
Liu Jiaqi shook her head blankly: "What did you hear? It made no sound."
Only then did Ling Feng realize that it seemed that only he could hear the sound. He calmed down, clenched the wooden stick in his hand, and asked the crystal man, "Who are you? What do you want to do?"
The Crystal Man did not answer his question, but his "eyes" (if the blurry light and shadow could be counted as eyes) turned to the jade pendant in his arms, and the voice in his consciousness sounded again: "I am here for it."
Ling Feng subconsciously covered his chest, where the jade pendant was sticking. "Do you know this jade pendant?"
"It's not the jade pendant," came the crystal man's consciousness, "it's the stuff inside."
"What's inside?" Ling Feng was stunned. He took out the jade pendant and held it up to the light to take a closer look. The jade pendant is still the same jade Guanyin, which is warm white and finely carved. Except for the tiny spots on the inside that are not jade, there is nothing special about it. "What could be in this?"
The crystal man "floated" forward for a short distance. It moved silently, without the sound of footsteps, just like a ball of light moving in translation. As he got closer, Ling Feng could see clearly that there seemed to be countless tiny light spots flowing in its "body", as if the entire starry sky had been crushed and packed inside.
"Navigation chip." The voice in the consciousness sounded again, with a calmness of stating the facts, "The navigation chip of Langs star, our spacecraft needs it to locate the coordinates."
"Lance Star?" Ling Feng chewed on this unfamiliar name, his heart beating wildly, "Are you...an alien?"
Even he himself felt ridiculous when he asked this question. But the crystal man in front of him, the consciousness transmission that only he could hear, and the weird blue light three days ago, all forced him to believe in this answer that was beyond his cognition.
title_en: Chapter 4 Crystal Visitor Chapter 5 Chip Secrets
